$schema_comment: SCDE Finance Dashboard design tokens. Brand colors sourced directly from 'SCDE Brand Guidelines (1).pdf' page 7 (Color Profiles). Semantic, projection, and categorical palettes synthesized to meet WCAG 2.1 AA on top of the brand palette. See design/style-guide.md and design/contrast-audit.md.

primary.rationale: Primary dark used for header, body text, emphasis.

secondary.rationale: Secondary dark blue; used for chart strokes and links.

accent.rationale: SCDE gold. Fails AA on white (1.77:1) so ONLY used as decorative chart color, on dark backgrounds, or inside badges with dark fg.

tertiary.rationale: Medium blue; AA-passing on white at 5.28:1. Used for subdued chart lines and hover states.

warning.note: Deepened SCDE gold family to reach AA for text.

neutral_bg.note: Page background. Fg must be primary (#2F3D4C) or deeper for AA.

border.note: Selected to pass WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.11 (3:1) on both white and neutral_bg. Use for form-field borders, table grid lines that must be perceivable, and focus rings on light surfaces.

border_subtle.note: Non-perceivable divider; use ONLY where the boundary is not required for comprehension (e.g., zebra table row background change). Never use as the sole indicator of an input field.

categorical.label: Okabe-Ito orange (pairs with SCDE gold family)
Neutral dark gray (replaces Okabe yellow which fails 3:1 on white)

data.categorical_note: Okabe-Ito-derived palette chosen for deuteranopia / protanopia / tritanopia safety. Index 0 swapped to SCDE secondary so the default single-district view reads as SCDE-branded. Index 7 (yellow in original Okabe-Ito) swapped to dark gray because #F0E442 fails the 3:1 non-text contrast threshold on white.

historical.treatment: Solid line, weight 2.5px, filled circle markers 4px radius.

projected.treatment: Dashed line 6-4 dash, weight 2px, hollow circle markers 4px radius stroke 1.5px.

band_fill.treatment: Fill between lower and upper 80% bounds.

partial_fy_badge.treatment: Gold pill with dark fg. Only ever paired with primary text — never placed on white as standalone text.

partial_fy_band.treatment: Wider band for series flagged partial_fy_adjustment=true; distinct from normal projection band.

insufficient_gap.treatment: Subtle diagonal-hatch fill over the projection horizon with the 'No projection — 4 FYs of history required' message.

mono.note: Not in brand PDF; synthesized for tabular currency alignment and COA codes.

xs.usage: Captions, axis tick labels, footnote text.

base.usage: Body paragraphs and default UI text.

elevation.notes: shadow.sm for table rows on hover and inline tooltips. shadow.md for KPI cards and chart containers above neutral_bg. shadow.lg for modal dialogs (export confirmation, method explanation) and the analyst-toggle flyover. No shadows on flat elements sitting directly on white — rely on border token instead.
